pages.prompt: Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Wide cinematic night shot. Tetra's pirate ship sails across the dark moonlit ocean. Tetra is visible at the wheel/helm at the back of the ship, both hands on the wheel, steering. The pirate crew works the lines. the Forsaken Fortress (a tall central stone tower with crooked horizontal yardarms extending outward like a dead tree, with multiple iron anchors hanging from chains off these branches; a smaller crow's-nest watchtower at the very top of the spire; lower stone walls around the base with small square glowing yellow windows; multiple golden searchlight beams projecting outward from openings in the walls) looms small on the horizon, its golden searchlights sweeping the sky. Cold blue palette with warm lanterns on the ship. Square 1:1, no text in image.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Medium shot. Toon Link stands at the railing of Tetra's pirate ship — clearly on the wooden deck, with the ship's mast, red sails, and rigging visible behind him, lanterns hanging from lines. He looks intently across the dark water at the Forsaken Fortress (a tall central stone tower with crooked horizontal yardarms extending outward like a dead tree, with multiple iron anchors hanging from chains off these branches; a smaller crow's-nest watchtower at the very top of the spire; lower stone walls around the base with small square glowing yellow windows; multiple golden searchlight beams projecting outward from openings in the walls) in the distance. His face is determined but a flicker of nervousness shows. Night sky, moonlight on waves. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. On the pirate ship deck at night. Tetra approaches Link, hand raised as if explaining. The pirate crew (Gonzo — huge bald pirate, Niko — gangly with blue hat, others with bandanas) stand behind her listening. Link turns to face her. Lantern light. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. On the bow (front) of the pirate ship — there is a large WOODEN CATAPULT mounted on a raised platform at the very front of the ship, with a long catapult arm and a wooden bucket at its end. Tetra points at the catapult bucket. The pirates grin. Link looks surprised but determined. Night on the ship. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Dynamic action shot. The catapult on the bow of the pirate ship — Link is curled up inside a sealed wooden barrel that has been loaded into the catapult bucket. Only his big eyes peek out a small hole in the barrel. The pirates work the catapult arm winding back. Tetra aims, one hand on the release. Night. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. ICONIC MOMENT. A wooden barrel (sealed shut, with Link inside) arcs through the starry night sky high above the ocean, a trail of motion lines behind it. The barrel is flying TOWARD the Forsaken Fortress (a tall central stone tower with crooked horizontal yardarms extending outward like a dead tree, with multiple iron anchors hanging from chains off these branches; a smaller crow's-nest watchtower at the very top of the spire; lower stone walls around the base with small square glowing yellow windows; multiple golden searchlight beams projecting outward from openings in the walls) which fills the lower half of the image — the barrel is visibly heading toward the wall of the fortress. Big moon behind. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. The wooden barrel has crashed against a stone wall — splinters of broken wood. Link tumbles onto a stone landing inside the flooded fortress base. His small sword has bounced loose from him and is falling away — he reaches toward it but it's already out of reach. Cold dark stone, water lapping at the base of the walls. Wind Waker dramatic. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. A bright pale-yellow searchlight beam (the WHITE-YELLOW spotlight color from the actual game, NOT red) sweeps across the stone fortress courtyard floor. Link in his green tunic ducks down behind a wooden barrel — just his eyes visible, huge with fear. A Moblin (large brown pig-boar warrior with helmet and spear) patrols nearby holding up its lantern. Yellow-white spotlight from the searchlight tower above. Dark wet stone. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Side-scroll view. Link crouch-walks very quietly past a sleeping Moblin slumped against a stone wall, snoring visibly (little Zs). Link holds a finger to his lips. Torchlight. Comic tension. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Interior of a tall stone tower. A spiral staircase winds upward. Link climbs up, looking determined. Warm torches on the walls cast flickering shadows. Cool blue-gray stone. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Link pauses on the tower stairs, head tilted, listening. His face is troubled — he hears something faint and sad. Stone walls, dim torchlight, long shadows. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Link stands outside a wooden door with a small barred window. Through the window he sees Aryll — small girl with blonde side-pigtails wearing her blue sundress with a red hibiscus flower. Her face lights up with surprise and joy when she sees him. She puts her hand up to the window. Link's face shows relief and determination. Torchlit stone corridor. Warm and hopeful — a brother finding his sister. Square 1:1, no text in image.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Link grips the thick iron bars of Aryll's cell with both hands, pulling with all his might, face straining with effort, feet braced against the stone floor. Aryll watches from inside, hands on the bars too. The bars do not budge. Desperate small boy. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. A huge bird-shape suddenly appears in a circular opening in the tower ceiling above — the Helmaroc King (massive bird with white helmet-like crest and red face markings) peers down with fierce yellow eyes. Link looks up in alarm, stepping back from the door. Aryll visible at the window. Dramatic low-angle shot emphasizing the bird's size. Cinematic, not scary. Square 1:1, no text in image.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. VIOLENT but family-friendly moment. The great Helmaroc King (huge dark bird with white helmet, red face markings, black and red wings) swoops from an opening in the tower roof, massive talons closing around Link's small body, lifting him off the floor. Link's legs kick. Aryll screams from behind the bars. No blood, dramatic cinematic framing. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. High altitude shot. The Helmaroc King flies high over the moonlit open sea, massive wings spread, with tiny Link gripped helplessly in its talons. The fortress is now small behind them. Vast empty sky, endless dark sea below. Terrifying sense of scale. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Devastating. The bird opens its talons — Link is flung, falling through the empty night sky, arms and legs spread, tiny against vast darkness. The bird flies away above him. The ocean yawns below. Lonely, powerless. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Underwater shot. Link sinks down into deep dark cold water. Bubbles trail from his mouth. His eyes are half-closed, exhausted. Light fades above him. Blue-black palette, silent and still. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Serene shift in tone. Link lies face-down on warm wet sand at the edge of a beach, dawn light painting the sky pink and gold. Gentle waves lap. His green clothing is soaked. Behind him on the sand: a small red wooden boat with an ornate golden dragon-head prow (the King of Red Lions — red face with yellow horns). Peaceful stillness, strange beauty. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. WONDER. Link is now sitting up on the sand, staring in astonishment at the small red boat — the golden dragon figurehead is turned to face him, eyes open, mouth speaking. Dawn pink and gold sky. Link's expression is pure 'did that boat just TALK?' Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. Link on his knees in the sand, hands out pleading, face desperate, eyes brimming. He gestures back toward the sea where the fortress lies. The dragon-boat listens patiently. Dawn beach. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. The REVEAL / turning point. Close shot of the King of Red Lions' dragon head — wise old eyes regarding Link with kind sorrow. Link in the foreground (seen in 3/4 from behind or side) listens. The single word 'Not yet' implied in the boat's expression. Quiet solemn moment. Dawn light. Square 1:1, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. LOW POINT. Link sits on the sand with his head hung low, shoulders slumped, hands loose in his lap. A single tear rolls down his cheek. The boat waits silently beside him. Soft dawn light. The emotional bottom of the story. Square 1:tt, no text.

Cel-shaded illustration in the style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Bold black outlines, textured cel-shaded coloring, bright saturated colors. QUIET RESOLVE. Link in green tunic sits in the warm sand on a beach at dawn, looking out at the calm sea. The King of Red Lions (small red wooden boat with golden dragon-head prow, NO sail raised — bare mast in the middle) floats just at the water's edge beside him. Soft golden dawn light, soft pink-gold sky, calm water. Hope returning. Not triumphant — endurance. They have NOT left the beach yet — this is the moment of decision. Square 1:1, no text.
